name: Kiln Out-of-Core Volume Rendering
definition: A WebGPU-native out-of-core volume rendering system for large virtualized volumetric datasets that streams multi-gigabyte volumes over HTTP, rendering them at interactive framerates using a bounded GPU residency/atlas cache and virtual-texture indirection.
summary: Kiln is a WebGPU out-of-core volume renderer that streams multi-gigabyte datasets interactively using a bounded GPU cache and virtual-texture indirection to manage VRAM without explicit tiling.
